name_note: GTDB places in this genus genomes that NCBI labels Ruminococcus or Mediterraneibacter as well as Schaedlerella.

sentences.text: Schaedlerella arabinosiphila was isolated from faeces of C57BL/6J mice and is a close relative of Clostridium species ASF 502, one of the eight strains of the altered Schaedler flora.
Its description reports that the rare sugar D-arabinose served as sole carbon source in the isolation medium, and that strain TLL-A1T carries a large gene repertoire for using varied carbohydrates.
A combined analysis of publicly available gut microbiota data from women with polycystic ovary syndrome reported that Schaedlerella was decreased in affected women compared with healthy individuals.
